## What PerfSage builds

1. PerfSage Reveal — upload JMeter .jtl, get charts, SLO verdicts, recommendations (Docker, OSS)
2. PerfSage SLO Reporter — JMeter Backend Listener for CI gates on p99, error rate, throughput
3. PerfSage SignalPilot — post-deploy Kubernetes RCA; correlates deploy diff, events, metrics, logs, git. Install: pip install perfsage-signalpilot

## Topics

Performance engineering, Apache JMeter, p99 tail latency, SLO/SLI/SLA, load testing, Kubernetes RCA, SRE, observability, chaos engineering.
